newsitem.title: USA: Seneca to buy Curtice Burns private label.
newsitem.headline: Seneca to buy Curtice Burns private label.

text.p: Curtice Burns Foods, a wholly owned subsidiary of Pro-Fac Cooperative Inc and Seneca Foods Corp said jointly on Tuesday they signed a letter of intent for Seneca to acquire certain Curtice Burns assets and to realign the sourcing of Seneca's New York State raw vegetable products.
Terms and conditions of the agreement are subject to ongoing negotiations and board approval from both companies.
The parties are working towards finalizing the agreement, subject to further due diligence by both parties, and expect to close by the end of March.
Curtice Burns processes and markets a variety of product lines of regional branded, private label and foodservice products in facilities located throughout the United States.
Pro-Fac Cooperative, an agricultural marketing cooperative which consists of over 600 members, processes fruits, vegetables and popcorn through its wholly owned subsidiary, Curtice Burns Foods.
Seneca Foods Corporation is primarily a fruit and vegetable processing company.
